## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows Conventional Commits, for example `feat: add day filters`.
- [ ] The branch name follows Conventional Branch, for example `feature/add-day-filters` or `codex/add-day-filters`.
- [ ] Commit subjects follow Conventional Commits, unless they are merge commits.
- [ ] I kept course content and personal learning claims grounded in notes actually provided.
- [ ] I kept day status in `src/data/journal.ts`, the single status source of truth.
- [ ] I ran `npm run build` and checked the result honestly.
- [ ] I preserved keyboard accessibility, responsive behavior, visible focus, and reduced-motion support where relevant.
